from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"test/fuzzing/chrono-duration.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":79,"var":"data[0]","code":"const auto representation = data[0];","note":"Attacker-controlled first byte selects the duration representation type used by the fuzzer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"test/fuzzing/chrono-duration.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":80,"var":"data[1]","code":"const auto period = data[1];","note":"Attacker-controlled second byte selects the chrono period branch that determines the formatter specialization."},
  {"step":3,"file":"test/fuzzing/chrono-duration.cc","function":"invoke_outer","line":27,"var":"data+fixed_size","code":"const auto format_str = fmt::string_view(as_chars(data), size);","note":"The remaining attacker bytes are reinterpreted as the format string passed into fmt::format/format_to."},
  {"step":4,"file":"test/fuzzing/chrono-duration.cc","function":"invoke_inner","line":13,"var":"format_str,value","code":"fmt::format(format_str, value);","note":"The fuzz target forwards the attacker-controlled format string and duration value into fmt's chrono formatter."},
  {"step":5,"file":"include/fmt/chrono.h","function":"chrono_formatter::on_second","line":1796,"var":"buf","code":"format_to(std::back_inserter(buf), runtime(\"{:.{}f}\"), std::fmod(...), num_fractional_digits);","note":"For floating-point durations, the formatter emits fractional seconds into a temporary buffer using the parsed precision."},
  {"step":6,"file":"include/fmt/chrono.h","function":"chrono_formatter::on_second","line":1799,"var":"out","code":"if (negative) *out++ = '-';","note":"The formatter conditionally writes a sign byte directly to the output iterator before copying the buffered digits."},
  {"step":7,"file":"include/fmt/chrono.h","function":"chrono_formatter::on_second","line":1800,"var":"out","code":"if (buf.size() < 2 || buf[1] == '.') *out++ = '0';","note":"A second direct write may occur before the buffered digits are copied, creating the sink that can overrun the destination when the output buffer is already full."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
